# 🐭 ProbeRat

AI Reliability Engineering Platform

##Vision

Probe beffore Production.

ProbeRat is an AI reliability engineering platform defigned for ttesting and evaluating AI services such as ASR,TTS and LLM.

## Tech Stack

- FastAPI
- HTTPX
- Locust
- mitmproxy
- Pytest
  -AI Agent(Planning)
